_source: Configuration audit of 22 September 2026 (paper Appendix B.2, Table 8 and the Table 1 provenance footnote): checkpoint files, adapter call paths, model cards and available historical launch logs. Launch-log evidence does not establish identical settings for every accepted episode. Keys are leaderboard display names.

provenance_legend.∗: Robot or latent-action pretraining followed by RoboTwin adaptation. The ∗ group does not imply that pretraining excludes RoboTwin.
provenance_legend.†: RoboTwin action-policy training from pretrained vision/language/video backbones; no additional robot-action pretraining reported.

scope_legend.§: Conditioned on task-name strings; this row does not measure instruction following.
scope_legend.¶: Near-zero success on RoboTwin source tasks; this row does not measure instruction following.

DM0.5.robot_pretraining: DM0.5 robot foundation model (Dexmal/DM05) adapted to RoboTwin
DM0.5.inference_path: No explicit future-image sampling in the inspected path; no explicit cross-request image history in the adapter.

π0.5.robot_pretraining: Third-party RoboTwin adaptation of the released pi0.5-base (10k+ h robot data reported by openpi)
π0.5.inference_path: Current observation; discretized state input is not discrete action output (not π0-FAST).

π0.robot_pretraining: Third-party π0 checkpoint; parent weights unverified
π0.robotwin_quota: 'clean-50' identifier, 35,000-step directory; data quota unverified (model card unavailable)
π0.inference_path: Current observation; parent checkpoint and training quota unverified.

StarVLA (Qwen3-VL-OFT).robot_pretraining: None reported beyond the VLM backbone
StarVLA (Qwen3-VL-OFT).inference_path: RGB and instruction only at the model boundary (no proprioception); continuous regression from action-token hidden states, not quantized classification or a diffusion head.

FastWAM.inference_path: Video co-training; the evaluated uncond path skips future-video generation. Instruction conditioning of this checkpoint remains to be verified.

AHA-WAM.robot_pretraining: None reported for the evaluated RoboTwin weights
AHA-WAM.inference_path: Video prefill every two action chunks; total configured horizon 64 (prefill horizon 32).

X-VLA.robot_pretraining: Not confirmed for this RoboTwin checkpoint
X-VLA.robotwin_quota: Repository entry: 50 demos per task; full quota unconfirmed
X-VLA.inference_path: EEF state and actions (ee6d decoded to 16-D pose/gripper, gripper threshold 0.7); cuRobo motion planning follows action decoding.

WLA.inference_path: Historical head images (history_obs_step = 8); 16-D EEF state/actions. Action sampling bypasses the World Expert and subtask-text generation.

GalaxeaVLA (G0.5).robot_pretraining: g05-base (14 embodiments + web/embodied VQA reported) adapted to RoboTwin
GalaxeaVLA (G0.5).robotwin_quota: 2,500 clean + 25,000 randomized; 4 epochs in the checkpoint config
GalaxeaVLA (G0.5).inference_path: Continuous actions enabled; autoregressive action tokens and CoT disabled. Server replan 24, client executes 8 of 32 predicted targets.

X-WAM.robot_pretraining: Multi-source robot/simulation pretraining (5,873.9 h, 1,492,026 episodes reported), including RoboTwin
X-WAM.robotwin_quota: 50 tasks × (50 clean + 500 randomized); RoboTwin also in the pretraining mixture (27,500 episodes / 113.7 h)
X-WAM.inference_path: Action-completion early stop enabled; depth branch disabled. 14-D incremental EEF actions decoded to 16-D absolute EEF targets.

Motus.robot_pretraining: Multi-stage video and latent-action pretraining (Stage 1 VGM, Stage 2 latent action) before RoboTwin (Stage 3)
Motus.inference_path: Inference returns predicted frames and actions; the full 16-action chunk is executed.

LingBot-VA.robot_pretraining: Large-scale causal video-action pretraining (≈16K h robot data, 1.4T tokens reported) before post-training
LingBot-VA.inference_path: Cross-chunk KV updates using execution observations; executes (F−1)·S targets on the first block and F·S afterwards, where F and S are returned frame and within-frame action dimensions. 16-D EEF actions relative to the initial pose.

GPT-6 Astra.backbone: External multimodal model API (reported identifier gpt-6-astra); returned provider version not independently verified
GPT-6 Astra.action_generation: Text / tool calls producing numeric EEF targets (move_eef, finish); not a quantized action codebook
GPT-6 Astra.inference_path: Three RGB views + EEF/joint state + tool results and contact feedback; text and tool history retained within an episode. 120-call budget, soft 3,300 s wall limit.

Gemini 3.8 Flash.backbone: External multimodal model API (reported identifier gemini-3.8-flash); returned provider version not independently verified
Gemini 3.8 Flash.action_generation: Text / tool calls producing numeric EEF targets (move_eef, finish); not a quantized action codebook
Gemini 3.8 Flash.inference_path: Same shared tool/controller interface as GPT-6 as described in the configuration report; independent verification of the full bridge configuration is pending.

GPT-6.2 Astra.backbone: External multimodal model API (reported identifier gpt-6.2-astra); returned provider version not independently verified
GPT-6.2 Astra.action_generation: Text / tool calls producing numeric EEF targets (move_eef, finish); not a quantized action codebook
GPT-6.2 Astra.inference_path: Three RGB views + EEF/joint state + tool results and contact feedback; text and tool history retained within an episode. Policy-exported instruction wording; 120-call limit; soft 3,300 s budget excludes API waiting.

Opus 5.5.backbone: External multimodal model API (reported identifier claude-opus-5-5); returned provider version not independently verified
Opus 5.5.action_generation: Text / tool calls producing numeric EEF targets (move_eef, finish); not a quantized action codebook
Opus 5.5.inference_path: Three RGB views + EEF/joint state + tool results and contact feedback; text and tool history retained within an episode. Policy-exported instruction wording; 120-call limit; soft 3,300 s budget excludes API waiting.

Gemini 4 Argon.backbone: External multimodal model API (reported identifier gemini-4-argon); returned provider version not independently verified
Gemini 4 Argon.action_generation: Text / tool calls producing numeric EEF targets (move_eef, finish); not a quantized action codebook
Gemini 4 Argon.inference_path: Three RGB views + EEF/joint state + tool results and contact feedback; text and tool history retained within an episode. Policy-exported instruction wording; 120-call limit; soft 3,300 s budget excludes API waiting.

findings: G0.5 ran in continuous flow-matching mode with autoregressive action tokens and CoT disabled (checkpoint config and historical server logs agree); the server replan setting alone does not specify the executed length, which the client fixes at 8 of 32 targets.

StarVLA (Qwen3-VL-OFT) regresses continuous actions with an MLP head and L1 loss; it is neither quantized action classification nor a diffusion head, and the bridge forwards RGB and instruction only, without proprioception.
WLA uses the 16-D end-effector interface (robotwin_all_eef, chunk 32). Its inspected action-sampling path calls the VLM and action expert without invoking the World Expert or generating subtask text.
X-WAM runs with early stopping on action completion and its depth branch disabled; scores do not correspond to a full 4-D depth-reconstruction configuration.

None of the twelve inspected inference paths outputs discrete action tokens, so the current results do not support a discrete-versus-continuous action comparison. Agent text/JSON outputs are not quantized action codes either.
X-WAM's published pretraining mixture already includes RoboTwin (27,500 episodes, 113.7 h). This establishes domain exposure, not exposure to the derived ManipScope combinations.
Prediction and execution lengths differ (G0.5 32/8, FastWAM 32/24, AHA-WAM 16 per chunk within a 64 horizon, Motus 16/16); none of these lengths is a measured control frequency.

Nine checkpoints report 50 clean + 500 randomized demonstrations per RoboTwin task (27,500 episodes); quotas remain unresolved for DM0.5, π0 and X-VLA. Equal episode counts do not equalize augmentation, sampling or compute.
